metadata.title: The commutator subgroup of the Torelli group of a genus-three surface has finitely generated abelianization
metadata.abstract: We prove that the commutator subgroup of the Torelli group of a genus-three surface with at most one boundary component has finitely generated abelianization. The proof combines Gaifullin's finite-generation sufficient condition with the explicit generating set for the Torelli commutator subgroup due to Brendle, Margalit, and Putman.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 亏格三 Torelli 交换子群的阿贝尔化有限生成
analysis.workSummary: 证明亏格三且至多一个边界分支曲面的 Torelli 群之交换子群具有有限生成的阿贝尔化。
techniques: Gaifullin 有限生成充分条件
analysis.breakthrough: 把 Gaifullin 的判据与 Brendle–Margalit–Putman 的生成集结合得到结论。
analysis.limitations: 有限生成的对象为交换子群的阿贝尔化，曲面亏格与边界数量均固定。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
